Implementation details:

public static int findSmallestInteger(int n) {
    char[] digits = Integer.toString(n).toCharArray();
    // find pivot
    int i = digits.length - 2;
    while (i >= 0 && digits[i] >= digits[i+1]) i--;
    if (i < 0) return -1;
    // find successor
    int j = digits.length - 1;
    while (digits[j] <= digits[i]) j--;
    // swap
    char temp = digits[i];
    digits[i] = digits[j];
    digits[j] = temp;
    // reverse suffix
    int left = i+1, right = digits.length-1;
    while (left < right) {
        char t = digits[left];
        digits[left] = digits[right];
        digits[right] = t;
        left++; right--;
    }
    // convert to int
    int result = Integer.parseInt(new String(digits));
    // ensure > n? It should be > n by algorithm. But just in case, if result <= n return -1.
    if (result <= n) return -1;
    return result;
}
